fields.description: Choose which document types can be signed with a Verified QR. Only documents listed below with "Allow Signing" ticked can be signed.

Controls how strictly signatures are validated. Each rule is opt-in and independent; combine them to match your organization's trust requirements. Locks, once enabled, apply to everyone including Administrator.

fields.label: Allow Multiple Signers Per Document
fields.description: Turn on so the same document can be signed by more than one user. Each signer gets their own Verified QR. When off, a document can only be signed once.

fields.label: Detect Tampering with Content Hash
fields.description: Stores a SHA-256 fingerprint of the document at sign time. If the document is edited later, the signature is automatically flagged as invalid in the PDF and on the verify page. Strongly recommended for production use.

fields.label: Lock Signature Records Permanently
fields.description: Prevents anyone — including Administrator — from editing or deleting Verified QR records. Turn on to guarantee a tamper-proof audit trail. Leave on in production.

fields.label: Use Stored User Signature Only
fields.description: When on, any signature image sent by the browser is rejected — the server uses only the signature stored on the signer's User profile. When off, the server still prefers the stored signature if one exists and only falls back to the client-supplied image when the User has no stored signature (this prevents a user from submitting someone else's signature image). Requires a Custom Field on the User doctype named one of: user_signature, signature, or signature_image. The handwritten image is consumed only by PAdES digital signing — the on-page stamp does not display it.

fields.label: Apply Real Digital Signature to PDFs (PAdES)
fields.description: Cryptographically signs every generated PDF so Adobe Acrobat Reader shows the signature panel. On first use, a self-signed certificate is auto-created — Adobe will show a yellow "signer's identity is unknown" banner until trusted. For the trusted green banner, replace the certificate with one from a recognized authority (eMudhra, DigiCert, Sectigo). See the README for the file path and upgrade steps.

fields.label: Signature Type
fields.description: What is applied when a user ticks "Apply Signature" on the Advanced Print page. Visual Block: 'Signature valid' stamp rendered on every page of the PDF. Cryptographic (PAdES): Adobe Reader signature panel (requires "Apply Real Digital Signature" above). Both: visual stamp plus PAdES.

fields.label: Watermark Mode
fields.description: Controls the watermark option shown under the Copies section of the Advanced Print page. Disabled: no watermark option. Document Status: single checkbox — the watermark text is auto-taken from the document's status field (or Draft/Cancelled for submittable docs). Custom Text: checkbox plus a free-text input where the user types the watermark.

fields.label: Verified QR Validity (Days)
fields.description: How long a newly generated Verified QR stays valid, counted from the signing date. 0 (default) means the QR never expires. Applied at sign time only — changing this value does NOT retroactively expire existing QRs. The /verify_document page returns an 'expired' status for scans of an expired QR.
Controls the /verify_document/ page that anyone can use to check a document's authenticity. Choose how much detail is shown to guests.

fields.label: Detail Level Shown to Guests
fields.description: Controls the maximum detail returned to callers who can already read the referenced document. Guests — and any logged-in user without read access to the target doc — always see only the status and signed-on date, regardless of this setting. Minimal: date only. Standard (recommended): document type, name, full timestamp, signer's name, and verification ID. Full: adds technical hashes on tampered results. The signer's email is never exposed by this endpoint.
Controls the Scan Me print UI on document forms — the Advanced Print entry point and which sections appear inside that page.

fields.label: Show Advanced Print Button on Forms
fields.description: When on, a document icon appears next to the standard Print icon on every allowlisted form. Click it to open the Advanced Print page. Turn off if you only want users to use the standard Frappe print view.

fields.label: Multiple Copies (Original / Duplicate / Triplicate)
fields.description: Lets users generate multiple stamped copies of the same document in one PDF.

fields.label: Header & Footer Repeat Rules
fields.description: Lets users choose whether the letterhead header and footer appear on all pages, only the first page, only the last page, etc.

fields.label: QR / Barcode Insertion
fields.description: Lets users add a QR code to any corner of the PDF, pointing to the Verified QR, the document URL, or custom text.

fields.label: Signature Block on PDF
fields.description: Lets users add a 'Signature valid' stamp on every page and optionally apply a real cryptographic (PAdES) signature.

fields.label: Live PDF Preview in the Dialog
fields.description: When on, the dialog shows a preview pane that re-renders the PDF whenever a user changes an option. Turn off for a compact dialog — users only see the PDF after clicking Download.
